# Motion 14.14.0

Copy of `dist/motion.js` (UMD build, global `Motion`) and `LICENSE.md` (MIT) from the npm package [`motion@14.14.0`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/motion/v/14.14.0).
Motion has no published WebJar, so it is kept here instead of in `pom.xml` (ADR 0016).

The tarball was checked against the registry's `dist.integrity`:
`sha512-a306U6sV5VKq1abtzKiinB+UQjiY88jrsvQzWORP3WPv/DFANyoYVlPbdnmJPMEbusyPXB4GyQJVANaq/pSIYQ==`.

To upgrade: download the new tarball, check its integrity, replace both files and update this note and ADR 0016.
